name: com.zhongxiaguchen.terrain2d
description: Editable 2D ground for Unity. An equal-spacing height field with a per-X height query, four independently editable edges (top / bottom / left / right), surface-following UVs for constant texel density on slopes, runtime destruction, seeded procedural generation, and automatic mesh + collider generation. A three-stage viewport toolbar walks the level through blockout, testing, and asset handoff, and ships with a controllable test character. Aimed at platformers that need destructible or procedurally generated terrain.
